Har video se pehle ye 4 step yaad rakho:
👉 Topic
👉 Title
👉 Thumbnail
👉 Script

Ek bhi step kamzor ho to video dab jaata hai. Pehle topic pakka karo, phir baaki sab.

Aapka sabse kamzor step kaunsa hai? Comment mein batao 👇
